scope: Phase 4: CP-2H builds its rating register from the context file's `ratings` rows (S&P, Moody's, Fitch) on a fixed combined scale; trigger terms from an attached `ratings` source
status: DRAFT 1 prepared by the cp2h-context-owner Task 0 preparer, 2026-11-01; review pending; not frozen, not pinned
raw_rule: ratings pages: literal UTF-8 LF, no terminal LF per page; U+000C joins ordered pages for the source SHA256 (as cases/cp2h-owner). context files: the bytes the form writes (JSON.stringify(o, null, 2) + LF; context-minified.json: JSON.stringify(o) + LF), sha256 of the file bytes, spans line:N via splitlines

sources.reuse: Every page text and locator stays byte-identical; read by reference, never edited
Every page text and locator stays byte-identical; read by reference, never edited

upstream: CP-0, CP-1, CP-2A, CP-2G closed chain as cases/cp2h-owner/manifest.json cases.positive (and gap for the gap case): every CP-2G metric and CP-1 ratio is the already frozen value

ratings_sources.name: Credit rating summary (fictional agencies)
ratings_sources.pack_limitation_positive: Synthetic agency summary naming fictional agencies; not evidence about a real issuer.
ratings_sources.pack_limitation_gap: Synthetic agency summary naming fictional agencies; one threshold is not stated and one rating is withdrawn.
ratings_sources.note: pages 1-2 are the frozen cp2h-owner pages (fictional agencies, fictional scale, scale positions 11/12) and are present and ignored by the context path; page 3 is the frozen page 3 with Alder Ratings -> S&P and Brook Credit -> Moody's (fitch_terms: S&P rows plus one Fitch row)
